Name: live-only-down-lowered-composite-key-undeclared-live-index
Text: DO $lc$ DECLARE duplicate_key text; total_index oid; live_index oid; BEGIN PERFORM set_config('lock_timeout', '5s', true); SELECT ic.oid INTO live_index FROM pg_index i JOIN pg_class ic ON ic.oid = i.indexrelid WHERE i.indrelid = to_regclass('"samples"') AND ic.relname = 'ix_samples_name_live'; SELECT ic.oid INTO total_index FROM pg_index i JOIN pg_class ic ON ic.oid = i.indexrelid WHERE i.indrelid = to_regclass('"samples"') AND ic.relname = 'uq_samples_name'; IF coalesce(obj_description(live_index, 'pg_class'), '') = '0200_live_only' THEN SELECT concat_ws(', ', lower("name")::text, "scope"::text) INTO duplicate_key FROM "samples" WHERE "name" IS NOT NULL AND "scope" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY lower("name"), "scope" HAVING count(*) > 1 LIMIT 1; IF duplicate_key IS NOT NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'cannot recreate unique index uq_samples_name on samples (lower(name), scope): duplicate key % exists, nothing was deleted', quote_literal(duplicate_key); END IF; IF total_index IS NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_class x WHERE x.relname = 'uq_samples_name' AND x.relnamespace = (SELECT t.relnamespace FROM pg_class t WHERE t.oid = to_regclass('"samples"'))) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Index name % is already held by another relation in the schema of table %: PostgreSQL index names are schema-global, so creating it would be skipped and the table would stay without its index. Rename the index.', 'uq_samples_name', 'samples'; END IF; CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "uq_samples_name" ON "samples" (lower("name"), "scope"); EXECUTE 'DROP INDEX ' || live_index::regclass; END IF; END $lc$

Rename the index.', 'uq_samples_name', 'samples'; END IF; CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "uq_samples_name" ON "samples" ("name"); EXECUTE format('COMMENT ON INDEX %s IS NULL', live_index::regclass); END IF; END $lc$

        CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION row_history_capture() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $rh$
        DECLARE
          v_old jsonb;
          v_new jsonb;
          v_unversioned text[] := ARRAY[]::text[];
          v_delta jsonb;
          v_op text;
          v_actor text;
          v_actor_kind text;
          v_actor_user uuid;
          v_tenant uuid;
          i int;
        BEGIN
          IF TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN
            DELETE FROM row_history
             WHERE source_table = TG_TABLE_NAME AND row_id = (to_jsonb(OLD) ->> TG_ARGV[0])::uuid;
            RETURN NULL;
          END IF;
          v_old := to_jsonb(OLD);
          v_new := to_jsonb(NEW);
          FOR i IN 3 .. TG_NARGS - 1 LOOP
            v_unversioned := v_unversioned || TG_ARGV[i];
          END LOOP;
          v_delta := (SELECT coalesce(jsonb_object_agg(o.key, o.value), '{}'::jsonb)
                        FROM jsonb_each(v_old) AS o(key, value)
                       WHERE (v_new -> o.key) IS DISTINCT FROM o.value
                         AND NOT (o.key = ANY (v_unversioned)));
          IF v_delta = '{}'::jsonb THEN
            RETURN NULL;
          END IF;
          v_op := CASE
            WHEN v_old ->> TG_ARGV[1] IS NULL AND v_new ->> TG_ARGV[1] IS NOT NULL THEN 'soft_delete'
            WHEN v_old ->> TG_ARGV[1] IS NOT NULL AND v_new ->> TG_ARGV[1] IS NULL THEN 'restore'
            ELSE 'update' END;
          IF TG_ARGV[2] <> '' THEN
            v_tenant := (v_new ->> TG_ARGV[2])::uuid;
          END IF;
          v_actor := current_setting('ormlite.actor', true);
          IF v_actor ~* '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$' THEN
            v_actor_kind := 'user';
            v_actor_user := v_actor::uuid;
          ELSIF v_actor = 'system' THEN
            v_actor_kind := 'system';
          ELSE
            v_actor_kind := 'unknown';
          END IF;
          INSERT INTO row_history (tenant_id, source_table, row_id, op, old_values, actor_user_id, actor_kind, xact_id)
          VALUES (v_tenant, TG_TABLE_NAME, (v_old ->> TG_ARGV[0])::uuid, v_op, v_delta, v_actor_user, v_actor_kind,
                  pg_current_xact_id()::text::bigint);
          RETURN NULL;
        END

        CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION row_history_capture() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $rh$
        DECLARE
          v_old jsonb;
          v_new jsonb;
          v_unversioned text[] := ARRAY[]::text[];
          v_delta jsonb;
          v_op text;
          v_actor text;
          v_actor_kind text;
          v_actor_user uuid;
          v_tenant uuid;
          i int;
        BEGIN
          IF TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN
            DELETE FROM row_history
             WHERE source_table = TG_TABLE_NAME AND row_id = (to_jsonb(OLD) ->> TG_ARGV[0])::uuid;
            RETURN NULL;
          END IF;
          v_old := to_jsonb(OLD);
          v_new := to_jsonb(NEW);
          FOR i IN 3 .. TG_NARGS - 1 LOOP
            v_unversioned := v_unversioned || TG_ARGV[i];
          END LOOP;
          v_delta := (SELECT coalesce(jsonb_object_agg(o.key, o.value), '{}'::jsonb)
                        FROM jsonb_each(v_old) AS o(key, value)
                       WHERE (v_new -> o.key) IS DISTINCT FROM o.value
                         AND NOT (o.key = ANY (v_unversioned)));
          IF v_delta = '{}'::jsonb THEN
            RETURN NULL;
          END IF;
          v_op := CASE
            WHEN v_old ->> TG_ARGV[1] IS NULL AND v_new ->> TG_ARGV[1] IS NOT NULL THEN 'soft_delete'
            WHEN v_old ->> TG_ARGV[1] IS NOT NULL AND v_new ->> TG_ARGV[1] IS NULL THEN 'restore'
            ELSE 'update' END;
          IF TG_ARGV[2] <> '' THEN
            v_tenant := (v_new ->> TG_ARGV[2])::uuid;
          END IF;
          v_actor := current_setting('ormlite.actor', true);
          IF v_actor ~* '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$' THEN
            v_actor_kind := 'user';
            v_actor_user := v_actor::uuid;
          ELSIF v_actor = 'system' THEN
            v_actor_kind := 'system';
          ELSE
            v_actor_kind := 'unknown';
          END IF;
          INSERT INTO row_history (tenant_id, source_table, row_id, op, old_values, actor_user_id, actor_kind, xact_id)
          VALUES (v_tenant, TG_TABLE_NAME, (v_old ->> TG_ARGV[0])::uuid, v_op, v_delta, v_actor_user, v_actor_kind,
                  pg_current_xact_id()::text::bigint);
          RETURN NULL;
        END
        $rh$

        CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION row_history_capture() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $rh$
        DECLARE
          v_old jsonb;
          v_new jsonb;
          v_unversioned text[] := ARRAY[]::text[];
          v_delta jsonb;
          v_op text;
          v_actor text;
          v_actor_kind text;
          v_actor_user uuid;
          v_tenant uuid;
          i int;
        BEGIN
          IF TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN
            DELETE FROM row_history
             WHERE source_table = TG_TABLE_NAME AND row_id = (to_jsonb(OLD) ->> TG_ARGV[0])::uuid;
            RETURN NULL;
          END IF;
          v_old := to_jsonb(OLD);
          v_new := to_jsonb(NEW);
          FOR i IN 3 .. TG_NARGS - 1 LOOP
            v_unversioned := v_unversioned || TG_ARGV[i];
          END LOOP;
          v_delta := (SELECT coalesce(jsonb_object_agg(o.key, o.value), '{}'::jsonb)
                        FROM jsonb_each(v_old) AS o(key, value)
                       WHERE (v_new -> o.key) IS DISTINCT FROM o.value
                         AND NOT (o.key = ANY (v_unversioned)));
          IF v_delta = '{}'::jsonb THEN
            RETURN NULL;
          END IF;
          v_op := CASE
            WHEN v_old ->> TG_ARGV[1] IS NULL AND v_new ->> TG_ARGV[1] IS NOT NULL THEN 'soft_delete'
            WHEN v_old ->> TG_ARGV[1] IS NOT NULL AND v_new ->> TG_ARGV[1] IS NULL THEN 'restore'
            ELSE 'update' END;
          IF TG_ARGV[2] <> '' THEN
            v_tenant := (v_new ->> TG_ARGV[2])::uuid;
          END IF;
          v_actor := current_setting('ormlite.actor', true);
          IF v_actor ~* '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$' THEN
            v_actor_kind := 'user';
            v_actor_user := v_actor::uuid;
          ELSIF v_actor = 'system' THEN
            v_actor_kind := 'system';
          ELSE
            v_actor_kind := 'unknown';
          END IF;
          INSERT INTO row_history (tenant_id, source_table, row_id, op, old_values, actor_user_id, actor_kind, xact_id)
          VALUES (v_tenant, TG_TABLE_NAME, (v_old ->> TG_ARGV[0])::uuid, v_op, v_delta, v_actor_user, v_actor_kind,
                  pg_current_xact_id()::text::bigint);
          RETURN NULL;
        END
        $rh$

        CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION row_history_capture() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $rh$
        DECLARE
          v_old jsonb;
          v_new jsonb;
          v_unversioned text[] := ARRAY[]::text[];
          v_delta jsonb;
          v_op text;
          v_actor text;
          v_actor_kind text;
          v_actor_user uuid;
          v_tenant uuid;
          i int;
        BEGIN
          IF TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN
            DELETE FROM row_history
             WHERE source_table = TG_TABLE_NAME AND row_id = (to_jsonb(OLD) ->> TG_ARGV[0])::uuid;
            RETURN NULL;
          END IF;
          v_old := to_jsonb(OLD);
          v_new := to_jsonb(NEW);
          FOR i IN 3 .. TG_NARGS - 1 LOOP
            v_unversioned := v_unversioned || TG_ARGV[i];
          END LOOP;
          v_delta := (SELECT coalesce(jsonb_object_agg(o.key, o.value), '{}'::jsonb)
                        FROM jsonb_each(v_old) AS o(key, value)
                       WHERE (v_new -> o.key) IS DISTINCT FROM o.value
                         AND NOT (o.key = ANY (v_unversioned)));
          IF v_delta = '{}'::jsonb THEN
            RETURN NULL;
          END IF;
          v_op := CASE
            WHEN v_old ->> TG_ARGV[1] IS NULL AND v_new ->> TG_ARGV[1] IS NOT NULL THEN 'soft_delete'
            WHEN v_old ->> TG_ARGV[1] IS NOT NULL AND v_new ->> TG_ARGV[1] IS NULL THEN 'restore'
            ELSE 'update' END;
          IF TG_ARGV[2] <> '' THEN
            v_tenant := (v_new ->> TG_ARGV[2])::uuid;
          END IF;
          v_actor := current_setting('ormlite.actor', true);
          IF v_actor ~* '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$' THEN
            v_actor_kind := 'user';
            v_actor_user := v_actor::uuid;
          ELSIF v_actor = 'system' THEN
            v_actor_kind := 'system';
          ELSE
            v_actor_kind := 'unknown';
          END IF;
          INSERT INTO row_history (tenant_id, source_table, row_id, op, old_values, actor_user_id, actor_kind, xact_id)
          VALUES (v_tenant, TG_TABLE_NAME, (v_old ->> TG_ARGV[0])::uuid, v_op, v_delta, v_actor_user, v_actor_kind,
                  pg_current_xact_id()::text::bigint);
          RETURN NULL;
        END
        $rh$
